why: next@16.3.3+ and sharp@0.35.4 cleared the two next RCE advisories (GHSA-p293-qw3h-jr36, GHSA-2xp9-vwfh-vxw4) and the sharp/libheif advisory (GHSA-rgj7-g3m4-5g8c) — real patch-version bumps, not baselined. maplibre-gl's GHSA-jrc7-96c5-q579 (DOM.sanitize() XSS in the attribution control) is baselined below because the installed 4.7.1 does not contain the vulnerable code at all: sanitize() was added to src/util/dom.ts starting in maplibre-gl 5.0.0 (diffed https://raw.githubusercontent.com/maplibre/maplibre-gl-js/v4.7.1/src/util/dom.ts against v5.0.0 on 2026-09-15 — absent vs. present). The advisory's stated vulnerable_version_range ('<= 6.4.0') is broader than the code history; upgrading past it means a 4.x -> 6.x jump (two majors) with real breaking-change risk for a fix that does not apply to what's installed. Re-verify this reasoning before bumping past 4.x, and re-check whenever maplibre-gl is upgraded regardless.
